_comment: Compute orchestration policy.  COMPUTE_MODE env var picks the active mode at runtime.  All scaling actions read the production-lock state — if locked or unhealthy, scaling is capped at local_only regardless of mode.

local_only.intended_use: single-process, single-agent — debugging or quiet windows

parallel_agents.intended_use: default; multiple agents run in parallel on the same host

burst_compute.intended_use: scheduled batch windows (regression matrix, contour sweeps); spawns up to 4 short-lived burst workers

heavy_analysis.intended_use: weekly deep audit; full repo scan + SDR correlation + multi-market validation

parallelism_rules._comment: Which agent pairs may run concurrently — agents that touch disjoint subsystems are safe to parallelize; the rest are serialized.
